About Us



Established in 1960, Electronics Weekly is the market-leading, longest-established electronics brand, read by key decision makers throughout the industry. Electronics Weekly reaches an international audience of 200,000 people each month across online, email, social media and events, and readers rate its editorial as informative, interesting and relevant. Our prestigious events portfolio includes Electronics Weekly’s Elektra Awards, Electronics Weekly’s BrightSparks, and the recently added Electronics Weekly’s Women Leaders in Electronics Awards.
